summary: Yamhill County, OR hilltop tower: 40-foot timber tower with live-in cab built 1953, abandoned 1965, removed May 1998; no source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Former Fire Lookout Sites and firelookout.com entries give 40 feet; a 1972 National Geodetic Survey description quoted by Forest Lookouts says the tower stood about 70 feet. facts.height_m uses the 40-foot figure from the two entries and the conflict is stated in the story.
firelookout.com says about 6 miles northwest of McMinnville; the 1972 survey description says about 8 miles northwest. The story gives six and notes the difference.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: gone, 40-foot height (12.2 m), Oregon Dept. of Forestry, 2010 FFLOS registration and elevation all match; no corrections. Three sources disagree on height (40 ft against about 70 ft in the 1972 NGS text) and on distance (6 against 8 miles); both are reported. The 1941 Lake County Examiner item is dated August 7, 1941 yet mentions 1938 as 'five years later', so its dating is unclear; it is quoted as printed. The 1941 lookout implies a station on the ridge before the 1953 tower, but nothing describes it, so it is not given a type or date. No source describes the hilltop today. A cascadedistrict.com place page failed to fetch (SSL error) and was not used. Budget: 2 searches and 3 successful page reads plus one failed fetch. facts.staffing 'as_of 1941' is the last lookout presence in the sources, not a current status. No photos added: the firelookout.com photo is credited to Gary Weber, with no licence shown.
